_status: Owner-approved 2026-11-02 top-two/all-eligible-denominator/maturity rules. Original supplied identities and artwork unchanged; source JSON/CSV retained separately. Equal family weights; category weights break ties only.

rules.select: two highest scored families; at least one valid eligible answer each
rules.ties: higher percentage, then higher possible category-normalized weighted points, then commit/measure/plan/do/engage
rules.next_step: weakest scored family; existing actual-answer Levers only

templates.subtitle: Your answers emphasize {noun1}, followed by {noun2}.

templates.footer: From current answers, not verified business behavior.
